metadata.title: Flow decomposition and stochastic completeness of weighted graphs
metadata.abstract: We give a new proof by flow decomposition of the known Grigor'yan type integral criterion for stochastic completeness of weighted graphs. The main ingredient is a finite-domain estimate relating the mass of a killed $1$-resolvent and the current reaching the boundary to relative capacities of intrinsic balls. This estimate yields logarithmic criteria in terms of capacity to infinity and relative capacity, and recovers the volume criterion by an intrinsic cutoff, without passing to a metric graph or refining the graph.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 加权图随机完备性的流证明
analysis.workSummary: 通过有限域流分解和杀死 resolvent 的边界通量估计，给出加权图随机完备性的容量判据及已知体积积分判据的新证明。
analysis.breakthrough: 直接在加权图上推导判据，无需转化为度量图或细化图。
analysis.limitations: 核心体积判据已有；增量在证明机制与容量形式，不是首次随机完备性判定。
analysis.priorityReason: 直接在加权图上推导判据，无需转化为度量图或细化图。
